aesthetic_reference: https://www.ravan.ai/real (Agni by Ravan.ai - Property Tour Engine & AI Voice Sales)

design_philosophy.core_concept: High-contrast editorial magazine typography on ultra-clean off-white surfaces with fiery Agni accent highlights
principles: Light Editorial Dominance: Deep charcoal/near-black bold text on bright white & off-white canvases
Massive Condensed Uppercase Headings: High impact headlines with tight tracking and uppercase authority
Agni Fire Accent: Kinetic fiery orange-red (#EA580C / #DC2626) for CTAs, active AI call states, and hot badges
Structured Story Numbers: Section numbering (01, 02, 03) with technical labels for magazine flow
Tactile Data Containers: Thin precision zinc borders (#E4E4E7 / #D4D4D8), crisp light-mode cards, subtle backdrop blur

hierarchy.hero_title: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none text-zinc-950
hierarchy.section_heading: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-zinc-950
hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-zinc-600 font-medium leading-relaxed
hierarchy.section_number: font-mono text-xs md:text-sm font-bold tracking-widest text-orange-600 bg-orange-50 px-2 py-0.5 border border-orange-200 inline-block

layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky top bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-zinc-200, z-50
component_guidelines.hero_section: Massive headline text, live call CTA button in Agni orange, subtle background architectural line art or real estate shot
component_guidelines.live_call_console: Interactive modal / embedded panel with real-time transcript streaming, audio waveform visualizer, AI lead scoring readout (0-100 gauge), action triggers
component_guidelines.dashboard_kpis: 6 light-theme KPI cards with crisp zinc-200 borders, trend badges, high contrast numbers
component_guidelines.crm_leads_table: Clean zebra or thin-bordered table on white background with filter bars, status pill tags, inline quick call button
component_guidelines.kanban_pipeline: 7-column swimlanes on #FAFAFA background with dragged lead cards in white #FFFFFF and sharp shadow-sm

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dropdowns, modal controls) MUST contain data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio: text-zinc-950 on bg-white is 19:1 ratio. Text colors on accents maintain > 4.5:1 ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application theme is light/white across all pages including marketing landing page and sidebar CRM app.
Remove dark class overlays or force-dark background styles (e.g. bg-zinc-950 or bg-black page roots should become bg-white / bg-zinc-50).
Keep Anton/Archivo Black/Bebas Neue fonts loaded for huge editorial headers on white backdrop.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements across components.
